name: maybe_Battle_ActionUi_Update
summary: Per-frame state machine of a 0x2014-byte battle action UI object; state in self[0x4E0] around 0x102E..0x10E6.
evidence: Decompilation is damaged (unaff_r8 in body) and 8200+ bytes long. Neighbouring callees (Battle_ActionUi_RefreshMemberFlags, Battle_QueueActionEx, Battle_MessageQueue_PushEntry) support the battle action UI context, but damaged registers keep confidence at 0.35.
